# Sources

Read 2026-10-29. "Read" means the page itself was fetched and its numbers extracted (through a page-reading
tool, so a long page is read as an extraction, not line by line). "Summary" means only a search summary or a
secondary page was read. Vendor means the publisher sells the thing it measures; LinkedIn is a vendor of InMail,
Premium and Sales Navigator.

## LinkedIn Help (platform rules)

| Source | URL | Read | One line |
|---|---|---|---|
| Personalize invitations to connect (Help 46662) | https://www.linkedin.com/help/linkedin/answer/46662 | Read | 200 characters, 3 notes a month free, Premium unlimited; updated about 6 months ago. |
| Invitation limit reached (Help a550555) | https://www.linkedin.com/help/billing/answer/a550555 | Read | Says 5 notes a month free (older page). |
| Invitation restrictions (Help 4800) | https://www.linkedin.com/help/linkedin/answer/4800 | Read | Three-week resend block after withdrawal, 30,000 cap, guidance. |
| Understand InMail credits in Sales Navigator (Help 57013) | https://www.linkedin.com/help/linkedin/answer/57013 | Read | 50 a month, 150 banked, 90 days, credit back on any response. |
| InMail credits and renewal (Help a541643) | https://www.linkedin.com/help/linkedin/answer/a541643 | Summary | Premium plan credit counts as quoted by vendor guides. |
| Voice messaging launch coverage (TechRadar) | https://www.techradar.com/news/linkedin-talks-the-talk-adds-new-voicemail-feature | Summary | Voice up to one minute, mobile, first-degree only. |

| Social Media Today on LinkedIn's 2022 InMail data | https://www.socialmediatoday.com/news/linkedin-shares-new-insights-into-maximize-response-to-your-inmail-messages/624430 | Read | Confirms the 2022 figures and the recruiter scope. |
| LinkedIn Talent blog, best time to send InMails (2016) | https://www.linkedin.com/business/talent/blog/product-tips/best-time-to-send-inmails | Read | No best hour, no best day; shorter bodies better. |
| LinkedIn Sales Solutions InMail checklist | https://business.linkedin.com/sales-solutions/resources/improve-inmail-response-rates/your-checklist-for-success | Read | 50 to 75 words; new-hire timing; "48% more pipeline" with no sample. |

| LinkedIn Sales blog, The most important bar graph (2014) | https://www.linkedin.com/business/sales/blog/prospecting/the-most-important-bar-graph-youll-see-all-year | Read | 1,500 buyers: 88% network, 17% cold. |

| LinkedIn State of Sales 2022 APAC page | https://business.linkedin.com/sales-solutions/b2b-sales-strategy-guides/the-state-of-sales-2022-apac-edition | Summary | 71% vs 50% research before outreach. |
| LinkedIn Sales blog, Prospecting gold (2018) | https://business.linkedin.com/sales-solutions/blog/best-practices--sales-prospecting/2018/prospecting-gold--how-to-earn-more-sales-referrals-on-linkedin | Summary | "5x more likely" via a mutual connection, no method. |
| LinkedIn Sales blog, 6 powerful stats | https://business.linkedin.com/sales-solutions/blog/6/6-of-the-most-powerful-linkedin-stats-for-sales-professionals | Summary | "71% more likely to engage", no method. |

Earliest trace found of "21x views, 9x requests"; links on to an earlier SMT photo-filter infographic (not read); no method. |

## Independent research

| Source | URL | Read | One line |
|---|---|---|---|
| ZEW press release, LinkedOut | https://www.zew.de/PM9285-1 | Read | 400+ fictitious profiles, 20,000 US users, 13% lower acceptance for Black profiles. |
| Evsyukova, Rusche, Mill, LinkedOut (QJE 140(1), 283 to 334, online Oct 2024, issue Jan 2025, doi 10.1093/qje/qjae035), ZEW discussion paper | https://zew.de/fileadmin/FTP/dp/dp24069.pdf | Not read (file too large for the tool) | Publication details confirmed through Crossref. |
| Zoe Cullen (HBS), NBER discussant slides on LinkedOut, 25 July 2023 | https://conference.nber.org/conf_papers/f187873/f187873.D_Cullen.slides.pdf | Read (PDF text extracted) | Absolute acceptance 23% vs 26%; recipients were LinkedIn-recommended people; shared employer or school about 2x (almost 40%); 21% answered the job-advice ask. |

## Vendor benchmark datasets

| Source | URL | Read | One line |
|---|---|---|---|
| Expandi, LinkedIn outreach benchmarks 2026 | https://expandi.io/blog/linkedin-outreach-benchmarks-2026/ | Read | 13.2M requests; definitions; seniority, industry, monthly trend. |
| Expandi, State of LinkedIn outreach H2 2026 | https://expandi.io/state-of-linkedin-outreach-h2-2026/ | Read | Openers, length, sequence length, send time, AI vs human within account. |
| Expandi, State of LinkedIn outreach H1 2026 | https://expandi.io/blog/state-of-li-outreach-h1-2026/ | Read | 70,130 campaigns; Builder warm-up vs Connector; follow-up increments; little method. |
| Expandi, LinkedIn acceptance rate | https://expandi.io/blog/linkedin-acceptance-rate/ | Read | Repeats benchmarks; no headline or photo data despite claims elsewhere. |
| HeyReach, benchmark report | https://www.heyreach.io/benchmark-report | Read | 96,051 campaigns; medians and diagnostic thresholds. |
| Belkins, LinkedIn outreach study | https://belkins.io/blog/linkedin-outreach-study | Read | Own 14,077 contacts plus Expandi 15M; note vs none on 11.5M; weekdays; AI. |
| Belkins, LinkedIn response time study | https://belkins.io/blog/linkedin-response-time-study | Read | 152,636 contacts; time to connect, reply, meeting. |
| Waalaxy, LinkedIn prospecting statistics e-book 2025 | https://images.g2crowd.com/uploads/attachment/file/1526002/_-E-book-Waalaxy-2025-_US_---Stat-prospection-Lkdn.pdf | Read (PDF text extracted; charts read from extracted labels) | Note, profile visit, gender, length, days, touchpoints, voice, CTAs, pronouns, Premium; samples in the annex. |
| Prospectio, outbound benchmarks 2026 (15 tests) | https://prospectio.ai/data/outbound-benchmarks-2026/ | Read | 15 randomized tests, 389,890 prospects; levels far above other sources. |
| Prospectio, voice note at step two | https://www.prospectio.ai/data/tests/voice-note-at-step-two/ | Read | Randomized, 5,915; reply and meetings; DACH caveat. |
| AISDR, connection notes test | https://aisdr.com/blog/linkedin-connection-request-results/ | Read | About 450 per arm, same warm-up; note: acceptance -2.7 points, reply 19.2% vs 2.6% of all leads (about 55% vs 7% of accepted). |
| Overloop, LinkedIn outreach benchmarks | https://overloop.com/blog/linkedin-outreach-benchmarks | Read | Secondary roundup: Botdog timing, Expandi follow-ups, and two "Belkins" figures not on the Belkins page (20M+ note vs none; profile visit). |
| SmartReach, State of LinkedIn outreach 2026 | https://smartreach.io/reports/state-of-linkedin-outreach/ | Summary | Compares vendor acceptance figures (21%, 18.7%, 28.5%). |
| La Growth Machine, social warming | https://lagrowthmachine.com/resources/the-dos-and-donts-of-social-warming/ | Summary | Likes first: 32% to 40%, no method. |
| Zeliq, double profile visit | https://www.zeliq.com/resources/linkedin-double-visit-social-selling-sequence | Read | One rep's 67% vs 23%, no sample. |
| Amplemarket, Duo voice | https://amplemarket.com/blog/duo-now-talks-on-linkedin-meet-the-first-linkedin-voice-ai-to-double-your-replies | Summary | "+150% replies" from 50,000 responses, no method. |
| Fuzzy AI, open profile messaging | https://getfuzzy.ai/blog/linkedin-open-profile-messaging | Summary | Reports one creator's 8,423 conversations (36.4% vs 11.4%). |
| Vidyard 2021 report (BusinessWire) | https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20210922005143/en/Vidyard-Report-Reveals-Sales-Teams-Using-Video-Have-Increased-Response-Rates-Reduced-Deal-Cycles | Not read (403) | Video response claims; known only through secondary summaries. |
